heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns any photo into a paint-by-numbers template on your device, and its Marginarium tells how it was made.
content_why: Visitors cannot open the Claude Docs chapters, so full stories on a GitHub page give the link something real to open.
avoid: Avoid cold machine imagery or any line that makes the agents sound as if they replace people, since they help Paul and he has the last word.
